storeListingCopy.fullDescription:
Video Downloader for Thinkific makes it easy to save course videos from any Thinkific-powered school to your computer.

How it works: Go to any lesson page on a Thinkific school, start playing the video, and either click the download button on the player or the extension icon in your toolbar. The extension detects the Wistia video stream, shows available quality options, and downloads it as a standard MP4 file.

It handles Wistia HLS streaming and embed detection automatically — no external tools, no command line, no technical knowledge required. Videos save directly to your Downloads folder in an organized thinkific subfolder.

Key features:
- Automatic Wistia video detection across all Thinkific custom-domain schools
- In-page download button right on the video player
- Converts HLS streams to standard MP4 files in your browser
- Quality selection from all available resolutions
- Real-time download progress with speed indicators
- Right-click context menu for quick downloads
- Dark-themed UI with sky blue accents
- 3 free downloads to try before you buy

Getting started:
1. Install the extension
2. Go to your Thinkific school and open a lesson with a video
3. Click the download button on the player or the extension icon
4. Select quality and download — saved as MP4

Sign in with your email to unlock 3 free trial downloads. Upgrade to a license for unlimited downloads.

Supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Firefox, and more.

faq.question: How do I download a video?
faq.answer: Go to any lesson page on your Thinkific school and press play on the video. Then click the download button on the player, click the extension icon, or right-click and select "Download Thinkific Video."

faq.question: Does this work on custom Thinkific domains?
faq.answer: Yes — the extension works on all Thinkific-powered schools, including custom domains hosted on *.thinkific.com.

faq.question: What quality options are available?
faq.answer: The extension detects all available qualities from the Wistia embed — typically multiple resolutions including HD. Formats are sorted by quality (highest first), with MP4 preferred over HLS.

faq.question: What format are downloaded videos?
faq.answer: All videos are saved as standard MP4 files that play on any device or media player.

faq.question: Where are my downloads saved?
faq.answer: Videos automatically save to a thinkific subfolder inside your browser's default Downloads directory.

faq.question: How many free downloads do I get?
faq.answer: 3 free trial downloads after signing in with your email. Purchase a license for unlimited downloads.

faq.question: Does this work on Firefox?
faq.answer: Yes — supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Whale, Yandex, and Firefox.

faq.question: Why isn't the extension finding my video?
faq.answer: Press play on the video first. The extension needs the Wistia stream to start before detection works. If issues persist, refresh the page.

faq.question: Is my data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. Video processing happens entirely in your browser. Authentication uses secure OTP — no passwords stored.
